#setting up packages 
```{r setup, include=FALSE} 
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

pacman::p_load(tidyverse,dplyr,ggplot2,lubridate,brms, data.table, cmdstanr, season, dlnm, splines, survival, gnm, broom, MASS)
```

#data sets
```{r}
# load medical incidents from SFDPH
medical_incidents <- read.csv("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/Fire_Department_and_Emergency_Medical_Services_Dispatched_Calls_for_Service_20260309.csv")

# load all current temp data
daymet_current <- read.csv("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/daymet_current.csv")

# load percentile (zip code level) from historical data (30 year normal) - includes min/mean/max of 85th/95/97.5th 
#limited to months 4-10 
daymet_percentiles <- read.csv("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/NOVEMBER/daymet_percentile_byZIP_stratified.csv") 
```


#calculating heatwaves + cleaning 
```{r}
# calculate AT from temp and vp 
daymet_current <- daymet_current %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(year = year) + days(yday - 1),
         month = month(date),
         apparent_tmin = -1.3 + 0.92*tmin + 2.2*(vp/1000),
         apparent_tmax = -1.3 + 0.92*tmax + 2.2*(vp/1000),
         apparent_tmean = (apparent_tmin+apparent_tmax)/2
         )

# merge data sets
daymet_current_join <- left_join(daymet_current, daymet_percentiles, by = "zip_code")

# remove duplicate observations
# Deduplicate by zip
daymet_heatwaves <- daymet_current_join %>%
  distinct(zip_code, date, .keep_all = TRUE) 

#tally heatwave days at 85th percentile mean
hw_975_mean <- daymet_heatwaves %>%
  filter(month >= 4 & month < 10) %>% #restrict to SF summer dates to avoid seasonal bias
  mutate(hw = apparent_tmean > p97.5_mean) 

hw_975_mean$zip_code <- as.character(hw_975_mean$zip_code)

hw_975_mean <- hw_975_mean %>%
  group_by(site, zip_code) %>%
  mutate(event_id = rleid(hw))

#summarise TRUE runs and 2+ day heatwaves
hwe_2day_975_mean <- hw_975_mean %>%
  filter(hw) %>% #keeps only heatwave days
  group_by(site, event_id, zip_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    duration = n(),
    start_date = min(date),
    end_date = max(date),
    mean_tmean = mean(apparent_tmean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(duration >= 2) # enforce 2+ days

#summarise TRUE runs and 3+ day heatwaves
hwe_3day_975_mean <- hw_975_mean %>%
  filter(hw) %>% #keeps only heatwave days
  group_by(site, event_id, zip_code, year) %>%
  summarise(
    duration = n(), #adjust to just "duration" if 
    start_date = min(date),
    end_date = max(date),
    mean_tmean = mean(apparent_tmean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(duration >= 3) # enforce 3+ days

per_day <- medical_incidents |>
  mutate(Call.Date = mdy(Call.Date)) |>
  count(Zipcode.of.Incident, Call.Date) 

per_day <- per_day |>
  mutate(year = year(Call.Date),
         month = month(Call.Date),
         Zipcode.of.Incident = as.character(Zipcode.of.Incident)) |>
  relocate(year, .after = "Call.Date") |> 
  filter(month >= 4 & month < 10) %>% 
  drop_na(Zipcode.of.Incident)

#97.5th mean 
overall_current_975_mean <- left_join(
  per_day,
  hw_975_mean,
  by = c(
    "Call.Date" = "date",
    "Zipcode.of.Incident" = "zip_code",
    "year" = "year",
    "month" = "month"
  ),
  na_matches = "never"
)

overall_current_975_mean <- overall_current_975_mean %>% 
  mutate(day_abbr = format(as.Date(Call.Date), "%a"),
         date = Call.Date)


```

#more cleaning + final df 
```{r}
overall_current_975_mean <- left_join(
  per_day,
  hw_975_mean,
  by = c(
    "Call.Date" = "date",
    "Zipcode.of.Incident" = "zip_code",
    "year" = "year",
    "month" = "month"
  ),
  na_matches = "never"
)

overall_current_975_mean <- overall_current_975_mean %>% 
  mutate(day_abbr = format(as.Date(Call.Date), "%a"),
         date = Call.Date)

dat_975_mean <- overall_current_975_mean %>%
  mutate(
    Call.Date = as.Date(Call.Date),
    year = as.integer(format(Call.Date, "%Y")),
    month = as.integer(format(Call.Date, "%m")),
    dow = format(Call.Date, "%a"),
    hw = as.integer(hw),
    cc_strata = interaction(Zipcode.of.Incident, year, month, dow, drop = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Zipcode.of.Incident) %>%
  arrange(Call.Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    hw_lag1 = lag(hw, 1),
    hw_lag2 = lag(hw, 2),
    hw_lag3 = lag(hw, 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# day 1 heat event
```{r}
irr_hw <- dat_975_mean %>%
  group_by(Zipcode.of.Incident) %>%
  group_modify(~ {                  #group modify runs data through the model by group filter  
    fit_lag_975_mean <- gnm(
      n ~ hw + hw_lag1 + hw_lag2 + hw_lag3,
      eliminate = cc_strata,
      family = poisson(link = "log"),
      data = .x
    )
    
    beta <- as.numeric(coef(fit_lag_975_mean)) 
    se <- as.numeric(sqrt(diag(vcov(fit_lag_975_mean)))) 

    data.frame(
      lag = 0:3,
      IRR_percent = (exp(beta) - 1) * 100,
      IRR = exp(beta),
      LCL = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      UCL = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

```

# 3 day hw
```{r}
dat_975_mean <- dat_975_mean %>%
  left_join(
    hwe_3day_975_mean %>%
      dplyr::select(site, event_id, zip_code, year) %>% 
      mutate(hw_3plus = 1L), #identifies when there is a 2+ day hw event
    by = c("site", "event_id", "Zipcode.of.Incident" = "zip_code", "year")
  ) 

dat_975_mean <- dat_975_mean %>%   
  mutate(hw_3plus = coalesce(hw_3plus, 0L)) #non 2+ day hw flagged as 0 

dat_975_mean <- dat_975_mean %>%
  group_by(Zipcode.of.Incident) %>%
  arrange(Call.Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    hw3_lag1 = lag(hw_3plus, 1),
    hw3_lag2 = lag(hw_3plus, 2),
    hw3_lag3 = lag(hw_3plus, 3)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

irr_hw_3plus <- dat_975_mean %>%
  group_by(Zipcode.of.Incident) %>%
  group_modify(~ {                  #group modify runs data through the model by group filter  
    fit_lag_975_mean <- gnm(
      n ~ hw_3plus + hw3_lag1 + hw3_lag2 + hw3_lag3,
      eliminate = cc_strata,
      family = poisson(link = "log"),
      data = .x
    )
    
    beta <- as.numeric(coef(fit_lag_975_mean)) 
    se <- as.numeric(sqrt(diag(vcov(fit_lag_975_mean)))) 

    data.frame(
      lag = 0:3,
      IRR_percent = (exp(beta) - 1) * 100,
      IRR = exp(beta),
      LCL = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      UCL = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

irr_hw_3plus_0lag <- irr_hw_3plus %>% 
  filter(lag == "0") %>% 
  arrange(IRR_percent)
```

#mapping
```{r}
library(sf)

zipcode_map <- st_read("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/NOVEMBER/ZIPCODE shp/geo_export_126f112d-7f06-47f7-bb0d-f7e0e23fbe65.shp")

neighborhoods <- st_read("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/NOVEMBER/neighborhood names/geo_export_29a9c648-385b-4365-9396-a28dafd91ef7.shp")

irr_map_3plus975 <- left_join(zipcode_map, irr_hw_3plus_0lag, by = c("zip" = "Zipcode.of.Incident"))

map_draft <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = irr_map_3plus975, aes(fill = IRR_percent)) + 
  geom_sf_text(data = neighborhoods, aes(label = nhood), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()

crosswalks <- read.csv("~/PH 699 Bilaoen/NOVEMBER/Analysis_Neighborhoods_to_ZIP_Code_Crosswalk_20261009.csv") 

crosswalks$zip_code <- as.character(crosswalks$zip_code)

irr_crosswalks <- left_join(irr_hw_3plus_0lag, crosswalks, by = c("Zipcode.of.Incident" = "zip_code")) 

irr_crosswalks_map <- left_join(zipcode_map, irr_crosswalks, by = c("zip" = "Zipcode.of.Incident"))

irr_crosswalks <- irr_crosswalks %>% 
  filter(lag == "0") %>% 
  arrange(IRR_percent)

map_draft_crosswalks <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = irr_crosswalks_map, aes(fill = IRR_percent)) + 
  geom_sf_text(data = irr_crosswalks_map, aes(label = nhood), size = 2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()

print(map_draft_crosswalks)
```
